scope: Post-hoc geometry decomposition on both previously inspected fixed-crop cohorts. Current-full-center/size/box arms use unavailable sensor predictions and are diagnostic only. Past arms use prior complete/missing predictions but synthetic boxes are not clipped and are not closed-loop or prospective evaluations. Only GT with positive size is scored; GT never constructs predictions. No tuning or change to the active registered16-video center-only experiment. Video bootstrap is descriptive, not training-seed or official benchmark evidence.
